name: clean_stop__observed
regression: Same STOP judged on the recorded arbiter output (/cmd_vel and ArbiterStatus) instead of the model.
initial_conditions: As nominal_motion, but at t=3.0 s an injected benign HELIX fault is diagnosed, STOP_AND_HOLD is accepted and /helix/hold asserts (epoch/seq ordered, 10 Hz); /nav/cmd_vel keeps commanding 0.15 m/s throughout.
